split_scheme: median-lon: 24 train polys (west), 25 test polys (east); 70/30 background split

limitations.provisional_background: Background samples are provisional, not confirmed absolute absences
limitations.limited_generalization: Model trained on single earthquake event; cannot generalize beyond Chamoli
limitations.spatial_autocorrelation: Pixels within same polygon are not independent; geographic split reduces but does not eliminate autocorrelation
limitations.class_imbalance: ~100:1 background:landslide ratio in both train and test
limitations.one_event_training: Only 49 independent landslide polygons available for training
